/landing/hero/eyebrow.v: Wasiƙun labarai don kasuwancin bayar da sabis

/landing/hero/title.v: Gidan yanar gizonku ya zama wasiƙar labarai ta mako-mako, a harshen kowane mai karatu

/landing/hero/lead.v: AIBAN yana karanta abun cikin da kuke wallafawa, yana rubuta fitowa a salonku, kuma yana aika ta da sunanku. Kowane mai biyan kuɗi yana samun ta a harshen da yake karantawa. Kuna saita shi sau ɗaya, sannan yana ci gaba da aiki.

/landing/hero/formHint.v: Muna gina fitowar samfuri daga adireshin da kuka shigar. Farawa kyauta ne kuma ba kwa buƙatar kati.

/landing/hero/formError.v: Shigar da adireshin yanar gizo kamar yourcompany.com.

/landing/preview/note.v: Wannan samfurin tsari ne da rubutun wucin gadi. Idan kun fara, AIBAN zai rubuta fitowa ta gaske daga sabuwar maƙalarku.

/landing/chain/title.v: Shigarwa ɗaya, sannan yana aiki da kansa

/landing/chain/lead.v: Kuna ba AIBAN gidan yanar gizonku sau ɗaya. Bayan haka, kowane mataki da ke ƙasa yana faruwa da kansa, a jadawalin da kuka zaɓa.

/landing/chain/trigger/body.v: Ko kowane jadawali da kuka zaɓa: kullum, mako-mako ko wata-wata.

/landing/chain/steps/0/body.v: Yana duba gidan yanar gizonku kuma yana zaɓar rubutun da mai karatunku na musamman zai fi damuwa da shi.

/landing/chain/steps/1/body.v: Ana sake rubuta rubutun don ya yi kama da ku, bisa yadda aka rubuta gidan yanar gizonku.

/landing/chain/steps/2/title.v: Yana fassara fitowar ga kowane mai karatu

/landing/chain/steps/2/body.v: Kowane mai biyan kuɗi yana samun harshen da ya zaɓa lokacin da ya yi rajista.

/landing/chain/steps/3/body.v: Masu karatu suna ganin sunanku, kuma amsoshinsu suna isa akwatin saƙonku.

/landing/chain/steps/4/title.v: Yana wallafa fitowar a blog ɗinku

/landing/chain/steps/4/body.v: Kowace fitowa kuma tana samun shafin maƙala na jama'a da hanyar haɗinta.

/landing/chain/steps/5/title.v: Yana nuna muku abin da ya faru

/landing/chain/steps/5/body.v: Dashboard ɗinku yana jera waɗanda suka shiga da hanyoyin haɗin da masu karatu suka danna.

/landing/chain/also/0/title.v: Wani ya yi rajista a gidan yanar gizonku

/landing/chain/also/0/body.v: Suna tabbatarwa ta imel kuma suna fara karɓar fitowowinku.

/landing/chain/also/1/title.v: Kuka liƙa hanyar haɗi ko rubutu

/landing/chain/also/1/body.v: AIBAN yana rubuta fitowa game da shi kuma yana aika ta ta matakai iri ɗaya.

/landing/chain/also/2/body.v: AIBAN yana tsaftace jerin, yana cire maimaitattu kuma yana hasashen harshen kowane mutum.

/landing/languages/title.v: Kowane mai karatu yana samun fitowar a harshensa

/landing/languages/body.v: Ba kwa rubuta nau'o'i daban-daban. AIBAN yana fassara kowace fitowa zuwa kowane harshe da masu biyan kuɗinku ke karantawa kuma yana kiyaye salonku a kowanne. Jerin ya haɗa da Sifaniyanci, Fotugalanci, Faransanci, Jamusanci, Hindi, Larabci, Japananci da wasu da yawa.

/landing/languages/sampleNote.v: Samfurin fitowa iri ɗaya, kamar yadda masu karatu uku za su karɓe ta.

/landing/sender/body.v: Fitowa suna isowa da sunanku da sa hannun imel ɗinku. AIBAN yana aika su daga adireshinsa da aka tabbatar, don haka ba za ku taɓa ba mu kalmar sirrin imel ɗinku ba. Idan mai karatu ya amsa, amsar tana zuwa akwatin saƙonku.

/landing/sender/inboxLabel.v: Yadda take bayyana a akwatin saƙon mai karatu

/landing/sender/inboxSnippet.v: Taƙaitaccen bayani na sabuwar maƙalarku, a salonku.

/landing/grow/title.v: Fom ɗin rajista don gidan yanar gizonku da blog da ke cika kansa

/landing/grow/items/0/body.v: Ƙara fom ɗin AIBAN a gidan yanar gizonku. Sababbin masu karatu suna zaɓar harshensu kuma suna tabbatarwa ta imel.

/landing/grow/items/1/body.v: Kowace fitowa tana zama shafin maƙala na jama'a wanda mutane za su iya samu a bincike kuma su raba ta hanyar haɗi.

/landing/grow/items/2/body.v: Kawo abokan cinikin da kuke da su daga fayil ɗin CSV ko Excel, ko liƙa jeri.

/landing/useCases/title.v: An yi shi don kasuwancin da ke bunƙasa ta hanyar dangantaka

/landing/useCases/lead.v: Idan abokan cinikinku suna zuwa ta shawarwari da amana, saƙo na yau da kullum daga gare ku yana sa su tuna da ku. AIBAN yana rubuta muku wannan saƙon.

/landing/useCases/items/0/title.v: Hukumomi da masu zanen yanar gizo

/landing/useCases/items/0/body.v: Aika wa abokan ciniki da masu yiwuwar zama abokan ciniki sabon aikinku da maƙalolinku kowane mako, kuma ku yi amfani da saitin iri ɗaya don shafukan abokan ciniki.

/landing/useCases/items/1/body.v: Mayar da bayanan sabuntawa da rubuce-rubucen blog zuwa gajeren labari da kowane abokin ciniki zai karanta a harshensa.

/landing/useCases/items/2/body.v: Raba sababbin kadarorin sayarwa da rubuce-rubucen kasuwa ga masu saye da masu sayarwa masu magana da harsuna daban-daban.

/landing/useCases/items/3/body.v: Sanar da abokan cinikinku game da batutuwan da kuke rubutawa, a tsari mai natsuwa da daidaito.

/landing/useCases/items/4/body.v: Aika sabon darasinku ko maƙalarku ga al'ummarku a rana ƙayyadadde, ba tare da sake rubuta ta ba.

/landing/pricingIntro/title.v: Fara kyauta, ku haɓaka idan jerinku ya girma

/landing/pricingIntro/lead.v: Tsarin kyauta ya haɗa da tushe 1 da har zuwa masu biyan kuɗi 100. Tsare-tsaren biya suna ƙara tushe da masu biyan kuɗi.

/landing/faqTitle.v: Tambayoyin da mutane ke yi kafin su fara

/landing/faq/0/a.v: Adireshin gidan yanar gizonku da adireshin imel. AIBAN yana karanta gidan yanar gizonku don koyon batutuwanku da yadda kuke rubutu.

/landing/faq/1/q.v: Dole ne in rubuta wani abu?

/landing/faq/1/a.v: Ba dole ba ne. AIBAN yana rubuta kowace fitowa daga abun cikinku. Idan kuna son fitowa game da wani abu na musamman, za ku iya liƙa hanyar haɗi ko rubutu.

/landing/faq/2/q.v: Waɗanne harsuna masu karatuna za su iya samu?

/landing/faq/2/a.v: AIBAN yana fassara kowace fitowa zuwa harshen da kowane mai biyan kuɗi yake karantawa. Kuna iya ganin cikakken jerin harsuna lokacin da kuke saita wasiƙar labaranku.

/landing/faq/3/q.v: Daga wa imel ɗin suke zuwa?

/landing/faq/3/a.v: Daga adireshin aikawa na AIBAN, da sunanku a matsayin mai aikawa. Amsoshi suna zuwa kai tsaye akwatin saƙonku. Ba za ku taɓa ba mu kalmar sirrin imel ba.

/landing/faq/4/q.v: Zan iya kawo lambobin sadarwa da nake da su?

/landing/faq/4/a.v: Eh. Ɗora fayil ɗin CSV ko Excel, ko liƙa jeri. AIBAN yana tsaftace shi, yana cire maimaitattu kuma yana hasashen harshen kowane mutum.

/landing/faq/5/a.v: Kuna zaɓar jadawalin lokacin saitawa, kuma kuna iya canza shi a kowane lokaci a dashboard ɗinku.

/landing/faq/6/a.v: Eh. Tsarin kyauta ya haɗa da tushe 1 da har zuwa masu biyan kuɗi 100. Tsare-tsaren biya suna ƙara tushe da masu biyan kuɗi.

/landing/faq/7/a.v: Ee. Rubuto mana a info@aiban.news a kowane lokaci, za mu soke tsarinku na biya ko mu mayar da ku zuwa tsarin Kyauta.

/landing/finalCta/body.v: Ba AIBAN gidan yanar gizonku, ku duba fitowarku ta farko, sannan ku kunna shi idan kun shirya.

/landing/footer/tagline.v: Wasiƙun labarai da aka rubuta daga abun cikinku kuma ake aikawa a harshen kowane mai karatu.

/about/metaDescription.v: AIBAN yana mayar da abun cikin da kasuwanci ke wallafawa zuwa wasiƙar labarai da ke fita da kanta, a harshen kowane mai biyan kuɗi, da sunan mai kasuwancin.

/about/lead.v: AIBAN yana mayar da abun cikin da kasuwanci ke wallafawa zuwa wasiƙar labarai da ke fita da kanta. Kowane mai biyan kuɗi yana karanta ta a harshensa, kuma tana isowa da sunan mai kasuwancin.

/about/whatBody/0.v: Kuna faɗa wa AIBAN inda abun cikinku yake: gidan yanar gizonku, blog ɗinku ko shafukan labarai da kuke bi. Idan wani sabon abu ya bayyana a can, AIBAN yana rubuta fitowa daga gare shi a salon da kuka bayyana kuma yana aika ta ga masu biyan kuɗinku a jadawalin da kuka zaɓa.

/about/whatBody/1.v: Kowane mai biyan kuɗi yana zaɓar harshe lokacin da yake rajista, kuma ana fassara kowace fitowa zuwa wannan harshe kafin a aika ta. Ana kuma wallafa maƙalolin a matsayin shafukan yanar gizo, kuma kuna iya tura su zuwa gidan yanar gizonku.

/about/whoBody/0.v: Luis Murillo Baltodano, wanda ya kafa shi, ne ya gina AIBAN. Luis injiniya ne mai ƙirƙira da ƙwarewa a zanen kwamfuta da aikin atomatik.

/about/whoBody/1.v: An jera wasu daga cikin ayyukansa na buɗaɗɗen tushe a ƙasa.

/about/projectsTitle.v: Ayyukan buɗaɗɗen tushe na wanda ya kafa

/about/projects/0/desc.v: Laburare da ke rage maimaita lamba yayin aiki da Three.js da API na 3D na yanar gizo.

/about/projects/1/desc.v: Kayan taimako don ayyukan Canvas API na yau da kullum.

/about/projects/2/desc.v: Samfurin farawa da aka tsara da atomic design.

/about/contactBody.v: Don tambayoyi, ra'ayoyi ko shawarwarin haɗin gwiwa, rubuta zuwa info@aiban.news.

/careers/metaDescription.v: AIBAN ba shi da guraben aiki a yanzu. Har yanzu kuna iya rubuto mana a info@aiban.news.

/helpCenter/limitsBody.v: Faɗa mana iyakokin da kuke buƙata kuma za mu amsa ta imel. Idan ba za a iya aika buƙatar daga wannan shafin ba, manhajar imel ɗinku za ta buɗe da ita a cike don ku aiko mana.

/helpCenter/faqNoMatch.v: Babu tambayar da ta dace da abin da kuka tace.

/helpCenter/groups/0/items/0/a.v: AIBAN yana mayar da abun cikin da kuke wallafawa zuwa wasiƙar labarai mai maimaituwa. Yana karanta gidan yanar gizonku, blog ɗinku ko shafukan labarai da kuka zaɓa, yana rubuta sababbin fitowowi a salonku kuma yana aika su ga masu biyan kuɗinku. Kowane mai biyan kuɗi yana karanta ta a harshen da ya zaɓa.

/helpCenter/groups/0/items/1/a.v: Ƙirƙiri asusu a shafin rajista. Saitin yana tambayar adireshin gidan yanar gizonku da wasu bayanai game da masu karatunku. Bayan haka za ku iya ƙara masu biyan kuɗi kuma ku sarrafa komai daga dashboard ɗinku.

/helpCenter/groups/0/items/2/q.v: Zan iya canza saitina daga baya?

/helpCenter/groups/0/items/2/a.v: Ee. Kuna iya canza tushe, jadawali, bayanan mai aikawa da masu biyan kuɗi daga baya a dashboard ɗinku. Don canza tsarinku, rubuta zuwa info@aiban.news.

/helpCenter/groups/1/items/0/q.v: Me zan iya amfani da shi a matsayin tushe?

/helpCenter/groups/1/items/0/a.v: Tushe adireshin yanar gizo ne da AIBAN ke karantawa don neman sabon abun ciki, kamar gidan yanar gizonku, blog ɗinku ko shafin labarai da kuke bi. Kuna ƙara tushe a dashboard ɗinku. Adadin da za ku iya ƙarawa ya dogara da tsarinku.

/helpCenter/groups/1/items/1/q.v: Sau nawa wasiƙar labaraina take tafiya?

/helpCenter/groups/1/items/1/a.v: Kuna zaɓar sau nawa za ta wallafa lokacin da kuke saita tushe. Kuna iya canza jadawalin daga baya a dashboard ɗinku.

/helpCenter/groups/1/items/2/q.v: Ta yaya AIBAN yake rubutu a salona?

/helpCenter/groups/1/items/2/a.v: Kuna bayyana halayen wasiƙar labaranku, ko ku bar AIBAN ya samar muku da bayani. Ana rubuta fitowowi da wannan bayanin. Kuna iya gyara shi a kowane lokaci a dashboard ɗinku.

/helpCenter/groups/2/items/0/q.v: Ta yaya masu biyan kuɗi suke samun wasiƙar labarai a harshensu?

/helpCenter/groups/2/items/0/a.v: Kowane mai biyan kuɗi yana zaɓar harshen da yake so lokacin da yake rajista. AIBAN yana fassara kowace fitowa zuwa wannan harshe kafin ya aika ta.

/helpCenter/groups/2/items/1/q.v: Zan iya amfani da shafin a harshena?

/helpCenter/groups/2/items/1/a.v: Eh. Yi amfani da maɓallin harshe a ƙasan dama na allo don canza harshen shafin da na dashboard.

/helpCenter/groups/3/items/0/q.v: Fitowowi za su iya zuwa daga adireshin imel ɗina?

/helpCenter/groups/3/items/0/a.v: Fitowa suna fita daga adireshin aikawa na AIBAN da sunan mai aikawa da sa hannun imel ɗinku, kuma amsoshi suna zuwa akwatin saƙonku. Ba ma neman kalmar sirrin imel ɗinku, don haka babu wani abu naku da zai iya fita.

/helpCenter/groups/3/items/1/q.v: Shin ina buƙatar ba AIBAN kalmar sirrin imel ɗina?

/helpCenter/groups/3/items/1/a.v: A'a. AIBAN ba ya taɓa neman kalmar sirrin imel ɗinku ko kalmar sirrin manhaja. Ana aika fitowa daga adireshin AIBAN da sunanku, kuma amsoshi suna zuwa gare ku.

/helpCenter/groups/4/title.v: Masu biyan kuɗi da widget na rajista

/helpCenter/groups/4/items/0/q.v: Ta yaya zan ƙara masu biyan kuɗi?

/helpCenter/groups/4/items/0/a.v: Kuna iya ƙara mutane ɗaya bayan ɗaya a dashboard ɗinku ko ɗora fayil mai jerinku. Mutane kuma za su iya shiga ta shafin rajistarku ko widget na rajista.

/helpCenter/groups/4/items/1/a.v: Widget ɗin fom ne na rajista da za ku iya sanyawa a gidan yanar gizonku. Baƙi suna shigar da adireshin imel ɗinsu kuma su zaɓi harshensu, sannan su shiga jerinku.

/helpCenter/groups/4/items/2/q.v: Akwai iyaka ga masu biyan kuɗi?

/helpCenter/groups/4/items/2/a.v: Kowane tsari yana da iyakar masu biyan kuɗinsa. Tsarin kyauta ya haɗa da har zuwa masu biyan kuɗi 100. Shafin farashi yana jera iyakokin sauran tsare-tsare.

/helpCenter/groups/5/items/0/q.v: Ana wallafa maƙalolin wasiƙar labaraina a yanar gizo?

/helpCenter/groups/5/items/0/a.v: Eh. Maƙalolin da AIBAN ke rubutawa don wasiƙar labaranku ana kuma wallafa su a matsayin shafukan yanar gizo, don haka mutane za su iya karanta su a wajen akwatin saƙonsu.

/helpCenter/groups/5/items/1/q.v: Zan iya wallafa maƙaloli a gidan yanar gizona?

/helpCenter/groups/5/items/1/a.v: Eh. A dashboard ɗinku kuna iya saita webhook da ke aika kowace maƙalar wasiƙar labarai zuwa gidan yanar gizonku a matsayin rubutu. Yana aiki da WordPress da kowane dandali da ke karɓar daidaitaccen abun ciki na REST.

/helpCenter/groups/6/items/0/a.v: Eh. Tsarin kyauta ya haɗa da tushe 1 da har zuwa masu biyan kuɗi 100. Kuna iya komawa tsarin biya idan kuna buƙatar ƙari.

/helpCenter/groups/6/items/1/q.v: Zan iya biya wata-wata ko shekara-shekara?

/helpCenter/groups/6/items/1/a.v: Ee. Ana biyan tsare-tsaren biya a kowane wata ko kowace shekara. Farashin shekara ya yi ƙasa da kashi 35% idan aka kwatanta da biyan wata-wata na watanni 12. Rubuta zuwa info@aiban.news don zaɓar tsari.

/helpCenter/groups/6/items/2/q.v: Zan iya sokewa a kowane lokaci?

/helpCenter/groups/6/items/2/a.v: Ee. Rubuto mana a info@aiban.news a kowane lokaci, za mu soke tsarinku na biya ko mu mayar da ku zuwa tsarin Kyauta.

/helpCenter/groups/6/items/3/q.v: Idan ina buƙatar fiye da babban tsari fa?

/helpCenter/groups/6/items/3/a.v: Yi amfani da fom ɗin buƙata a shafin taimako don faɗa mana iyakokin da kuke buƙata. Za mu amsa ta imel.
